newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIA in sale and leaseback agreement.
newsitem.headline: SIA in sale and leaseback agreement.

text.p: Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) said on Friday it has recently signed an agreement to sell and leaseback a 1992 vintage B747-400 aircraft.
A company statement said the arrangement will enable SIA to take advantage of the strong market value of the B747-400.
The agreement is with 747 Investors I.L.P., a special purpose company set up solely to buy and leaseback the aircraft to SIA for seven-and-a-half years.
The company is owned by an investment fund managed by Farallon Capital Management of San Francisco.
Babcock and Brown Inc acted as financial advisor to SIA for the leaseback arrangements.
